278    /**
279     * @return the order to initialize regular variables
280     */
281    private List<AstClafer> initOrder() {
282        List<AstAbstractClafer> abstractClafers = analysis.getAbstractClafers();
283        List<AstConcreteClafer> concreteClafers = analysis.getConcreteClafers();
284
285        KeyGraph<AstClafer> dependency = new KeyGraph<>();
286        for (AstAbstractClafer abstractClafer : abstractClafers) {
287            Vertex<AstClafer> node = dependency.getVertex(abstractClafer);
288            abstractClafer.getSubs().stream().map(dependency::getVertex).forEach(node::addNeighbour);
289        }
290        for (AstConcreteClafer concreteClafer : concreteClafers) {
291            Vertex<AstClafer> node = dependency.getVertex(concreteClafer);
292            if (Format.ParentGroup.equals(getFormat(concreteClafer))) {
293                /*
294                 * Low group does not create the dependency because it does not
295                 * require the parent to initialize first. This allows for
296                 * models like the one below.
297                 *
298                 * abstract Path
299                 *     p : Path ?
300                 *
301                 * If the "?" were a fixed cardinality instead, then an
302                 * exception will occur, but the model would not be satisfiable
303                 * anyways for any fixed cardinality greater than zero.
304                 */
305                node.addNeighbour(dependency.getVertex(concreteClafer.getParent()));
306            }
307        }
308        List<Set<AstClafer>> components = GraphUtil.computeStronglyConnectedComponents(dependency);
309        List<AstClafer> clafers = new ArrayList<>();
310        for (Set<AstClafer> component : components) {
311            if (component.size() != 1) {
312                // See the above comment about low groups.
313                throw new AstException("Cannot satisfy the cycle " + component);
314            }
315            clafers.addAll(component);
316        }
317        return clafers;
318    }
319
320    private static boolean isThis(AstSetExpr expr) {
321        if (expr instanceof AstThis) {
322            return true;
323        }
324        if (expr instanceof AstDowncast) {
325            AstDowncast cast = (AstDowncast) expr;
326            return isThis(cast.base());
327        }
328        if (expr instanceof AstUpcast) {
329            AstUpcast cast = (AstUpcast) expr;
330            return isThis(cast.base());
331        }
332        return false;
333    }
334
335    /**
336     * Checks if the constraint can always be enforced regardless if the
337     * attached Clafer exists or not.
338     *
339     * @param expr
340     * @return {@code false} if {@code expr} can always be enforced,
341     * {@code true} otherwise or unknown
342     */
343    private static boolean isConditional(AstBoolExpr expr) {
344        // this not in ___
345        if (expr instanceof AstMembership) {
346            AstMembership membership = (AstMembership) expr;
347            switch (membership.op()) {
348                case NotIn:
349                    return !isThis(membership.member());
350            }
351        } else if (expr instanceof AstSetTest) {
352            AstSetTest membership = (AstSetTest) expr;
353            switch (membership.op()) {
354                case NotEqual:
355                    return !isThis(membership.left()) && !isThis(membership.right());
356            }
357        }
358        return true;
359    }
360
361    private AstSolutionMap compile() {
362        IrSetVar rootSet = constant(new int[]{0});
363        sets.put(analysis.getModel().getRoot(), rootSet);
364        siblingSets.put(analysis.getModel().getRoot(), new IrSetVar[]{rootSet});
365        memberships.put(analysis.getModel().getRoot(), new IrBoolVar[]{True});
366
367        List<AstClafer> clafers = initOrder();
368        for (AstClafer clafer : clafers) {
369            if (clafer instanceof AstConcreteClafer && !AstUtil.isRoot((AstConcreteClafer) clafer)) {
370                initConcrete((AstConcreteClafer) clafer);
371            } else if (clafer instanceof AstAbstractClafer) {
372                initAbstract((AstAbstractClafer) clafer);
373            }
374        }
375        for (AstClafer clafer : clafers) {
376            if (clafer instanceof AstConcreteClafer && !AstUtil.isRoot((AstConcreteClafer) clafer)) {
377                constrainConcrete((AstConcreteClafer) clafer);
378            } else if (clafer instanceof AstAbstractClafer) {
379                constrainAbstract((AstAbstractClafer) clafer);
380            }
381        }
382
383        Map<AstConstraint, IrBoolVar> softVars = new HashMap<>();
384        for (AstConstraint constraint : analysis.getConstraints()) {
385            AstClafer clafer = constraint.getContext();
386            AstBoolExpr expr = analysis.getExpr(constraint);
387            int scope = getScope(clafer);
388            if (analysis.isHard(constraint)) {
389                for (int j = 0; j < scope; j++) {
390                    ExpressionCompiler expressionCompiler = new ExpressionCompiler(clafer, j);
391                    IrBoolExpr thisConstraint = expressionCompiler.compile(expr);
392                    IrBoolExpr conditionalConstraint = isConditional(expr)
393                            ? implies(memberships.get(clafer)[j], thisConstraint)
394                            : thisConstraint;
395                    module.addConstraint(conditionalConstraint);
396                }
397            } else {
398                IrBoolVar softVar = bool(constraint.toString());
399                softVars.put(constraint, softVar);
400                for (int j = 0; j < scope; j++) {
401                    ExpressionCompiler expressionCompiler = new ExpressionCompiler(clafer, j);
402                    IrBoolExpr thisConstraint = expressionCompiler.compile(expr);
403                    IrBoolExpr conditionalConstraint = isConditional(expr)
404                            ? implies(memberships.get(clafer)[j], thisConstraint)
405                            : thisConstraint;
406                    module.addConstraint(ifOnlyIf(softVar, conditionalConstraint));
407                }
408                module.addVariable(softVar);
409            }
410        }
411        IrIntExpr softSum = add(softVars.values());
412        IrIntVar sumSoftVars = domainInt("SumSoftVar", softSum.getDomain());
413        module.addConstraint(equal(sumSoftVars, softSum));
414
415        siblingSets.values().forEach(module::addVariables);
416        siblingBounds.values().forEach(module::addVariables);
417        refPointers.values().forEach(module::addVariables);
418        refStrings.values().forEach(module::addVariables);
419
420        for (Set<AstClafer> component : analysis.getClafersInParentAndSubOrder()) {
421            if (component.size() > 1) {
422                /*
423                 * Add additional constraints for to handle cases where a
424                 * descendent inherits an ancestor.
425                 *
426                 * Let A be an abstract Clafer and B be a descendant of A that
427                 * inherits A. Let F be a mapping every B to its ancestor A.
428                 * Enforce that F is an acyclic function.
429                 */
430                AstAbstractClafer unionType = (AstAbstractClafer) AstUtil.getLowestCommonSupertype(component);
431                IrIntExpr[] edges = new IrIntExpr[getScope(unionType)];
432                IrIntExpr uninitialized = constant(edges.length);
433                Arrays.fill(edges, uninitialized);
434                for (AstClafer clafer : component) {
435                    if (clafer instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
436                        AstConcreteClafer concreteChild = (AstConcreteClafer) clafer;
437                        IrBoolExpr[] members = memberships.get(concreteChild);
438                        IrIntExpr[] parents = parentPointers.get(concreteChild);
439                        int offset = getOffset(unionType, concreteChild);
440                        int parentOffset = getOffset(unionType, concreteChild.getParent());
441                        for (int i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
442                            assert edges[i + offset] == uninitialized;
443                            IrIntExpr value = ternary(members[i],
444                                    // Add the offset to upcast the parent pointer
445                                    add(parents[i], parentOffset),
446                                    uninitialized);
447                            IrIntVar edge = domainInt(
448                                    "Edge@" + concreteChild + "->" + concreteChild.getParent() + "#" + i,
449                                    value.getDomain());
450                            module.addConstraint(equal(edge, value));
451                            edges[i + offset] = edge;
452                        }
453                    }
454                }
455                for (AstClafer clafer : component) {
456                    if (clafer instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
457                        IrBoolExpr[] members = memberships.get(clafer);
458                        int offset = getOffset(unionType, clafer);
459                        for (int i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
460                            for (int j = i + 1; j < members.length; j++) {
461                                /*
462                                 * Symmetry breaking. The lower indexed element
463                                 * appears on top of the higher indexed element.
464                                 */
465                                module.addConstraint(unreachable(edges, i + offset, j + offset));
466                            }
467                        }
468                    }
469                }
470                module.addConstraint(acyclic(edges));
471            }
472        }
473
474        ExpressionCompiler expressionCompiler = new ExpressionCompiler(analysis.getModel().getRoot(), 0);
475        Map<Objective, IrIntVar> objectiveVars = new HashMap<>();
476        Map<Objective, AstSetExpr> objectives = analysis.getObjectiveExprs();
477        for (Entry<Objective, AstSetExpr> objective : objectives.entrySet()) {
478            IrIntExpr objectiveExpr = expressionCompiler.asInt(
479                    expressionCompiler.compile(objective.getValue()));
480            IrIntVar objectiveVar = domainInt("Objective" + objective.getKey(),
481                    objectiveExpr.getDomain());
482            module.addConstraint(equal(objectiveVar, objectiveExpr));
483            module.addVariable(objectiveVar);
484            objectiveVars.put(objective.getKey(), objectiveVar);
485        }
486        Map<Assertion, IrBoolVar> assertionVars = new HashMap<>();
487        Map<Assertion, AstBoolExpr> assertions = analysis.getAssertionExprs();
488        for (Entry<Assertion, AstBoolExpr> assertion : assertions.entrySet()) {
489            IrBoolExpr assertionExpr = expressionCompiler.compile(assertion.getValue());
490            IrBoolVar assertionVar = bool("Assertion" + assertion.getKey());
491            module.addConstraint(xor(assertionVar, assertionExpr));
492            module.addVariable(assertionVar);
493            assertionVars.put(assertion.getKey(), assertionVar);
494        }
495
496        KeyGraph<Either<IrExpr, IrBoolExpr>> dependencies = new KeyGraph<>();
497        for (Symmetry symmetry : symmetries) {
498            IrBoolExpr constraint = symmetry.getConstraint();
499            Vertex<Either<IrExpr, IrBoolExpr>> constraintNode
500                    = dependencies.getVertex(Either.<IrExpr, IrBoolExpr>right(constraint));
501            for (IrExpr output : symmetry.getOutput()) {
502                dependencies.getVertex(Either.<IrExpr, IrBoolExpr>left(output))
503                        .addNeighbour(constraintNode);
504            }
505            for (IrExpr input : symmetry.getInput()) {
506                constraintNode.addNeighbour(
507                        dependencies.getVertex(Either.<IrExpr, IrBoolExpr>left(input)));
508            }
509        }
510        Set<IrVar> variables = module.getVariables();
511        Set<Vertex<Either<IrExpr, IrBoolExpr>>> start
512                = variables.stream().map(Either::<IrExpr, IrBoolExpr>left).map(dependencies::getVertexIfPresent)
513                .filter(Objects::nonNull).collect(Collectors.toSet());
514        Set<Either<IrExpr, IrBoolExpr>> reachables = GraphUtil.reachable(start, dependencies);
515        Either.filterRight(reachables.stream()).forEach(module::addConstraint);
516
517        return new AstSolutionMap(analysis.getModel(),
518                memberships,
519                siblingSets, siblingBounds,
520                refPointers, refStrings,
521                softVars, sumSoftVars,
522                objectiveVars, assertionVars, analysis);
523    }
524
525    private void initConcrete(AstConcreteClafer clafer) {
526        parentPointers.put(clafer, buildParentPointers(clafer));
527        buildRef(clafer);
528        Format format = getFormat(clafer);
529        switch (format) {
530            case LowGroup:
531                initLowGroupConcrete(clafer);
532                break;
533            case ParentGroup:
534                initParentGroupConcrete(clafer);
535                break;
536            default:
537                throw new AstException();
538        }
539
540        IrSetVar[] siblingSet = siblingSets.get(clafer);
541        switch (siblingSet.length) {
542            case 0:
543                sets.put(clafer, EmptySet);
544                break;
545            case 1:
546                sets.put(clafer, siblingSet[0]);
547                break;
548            default:
549                int lowGlobalCard = getGlobalCard(clafer).getLow();
550                IrSetExpr union = union(siblingSet, true);
551                IrSetVar set = set(clafer.getName(), union.getEnv(),
552                        format.equals(Format.LowGroup) ? union.getKer().union(fromToDomain(0, lowGlobalCard)) : union.getKer(),
553                        union.getCard().boundLow(lowGlobalCard));
554                module.addConstraint(equal(set, union));
555                sets.put(clafer, set);
556                break;
557        }
558        IrIntVar[] bounds = siblingBounds.get(clafer);
559        if (bounds != null && bounds.length > 0) {
560            module.addConstraint(equal(bounds[bounds.length - 1], card(sets.get(clafer))));
561        }
562
563        if (fullSymmetryBreaking) {
564            int scope = getScope(clafer);
565            int parentScope = getScope(clafer.getParent());
566            IrIntExpr[][] index;
567            AstRef ref = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(clafer);
568            // If the Clafer either needs children or reference to be introduce symmetry.
569            if (analysis.hasInteritedBreakableChildren(clafer)
570                    || (ref != null && analysis.isBreakableRef(ref))
571                    || analysis.isInheritedBreakableTarget(clafer)) {
572                index = new IrIntExpr[parentScope][getCard(clafer).getHigh()];
573                for (int i = 0; i < index.length; i++) {
574                    for (int j = 0; j < index[i].length; j++) {
575                        index[i][j]
576                                = boundInt(clafer.getName() + "@Index#" + i + "#" + j, -1, scope);
577                    }
578                }
579            } else {
580                // Optimize for nonsymmetric nodes. Don't compute the smallest indices, 
581                // just use the cardinalities.
582                IrSetVar[] childSet = siblingSets.get(clafer);
583                index = new IrIntExpr[childSet.length][];
584                for (int i = 0; i < index.length; i++) {
585                    index[i] = new IrIntExpr[]{card(childSet[i])};
586                }
587            }
588            indices.put(clafer, index);
589        }
590    }
591
592    private void constrainConcrete(AstConcreteClafer clafer) {
593        IrSetExpr[] siblingSet = siblingSets.get(clafer);
594        IrIntExpr[] parents = parentPointers.get(clafer);
595        if (!getPartialSolution(clafer).parentSolutionKnown()) {
596            if (getGlobalCard(clafer).isExact()) {
597                // No unused
598                module.addConstraint(intChannel(parents, siblingSet));
599            } else {
600                IrSetVar unused = set(clafer.getName() + "@Unused", getPartialSolution(clafer).getUnknownClafers());
601                module.addConstraint(intChannel(parents, Util.snoc(siblingSet, unused)));
602            }
603        }
604
605        AstRef ref = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(clafer);
606        int refOffset = ref == null ? 0 : getOffset(ref.getSourceType(), clafer);
607
608        int scope = getScope(clafer);
609        IrBoolExpr[] members = memberships.get(clafer);
610
611        // Two ids a and b are in the same partition if symmetry breaking guarantees
612        // that ref[a] and ref[b] ard different.
613        DisjointSets<Integer> refPartitions = null;
614        // If the Clafer either needs children or reference to be introduce symmetry.
615        if (fullSymmetryBreaking && scope > 1
616                && (analysis.hasInteritedBreakableChildren(clafer)
617                || (ref != null && analysis.isBreakableRef(ref))
618                || analysis.isInheritedBreakableTarget(clafer))) {
619
620            IrIntExpr[] weight = new IrIntExpr[scope];
621            IrIntExpr[][] index = indices.get(clafer);
622
623            analysis.getHierarcyIds(clafer, refOffset);
624            IrIntExpr[][] childIndices = new IrIntExpr[weight.length][];
625
626            List<Pair<AstClafer, Integer>> offsets = analysis.getHierarcyOffsets(clafer);
627            Collections.reverse(offsets);
628            boolean[] breakableRefIds = new boolean[childIndices.length];
629            for (int i = 0; i < childIndices.length; i++) {
630                List<IrIntExpr> childIndex = new ArrayList<>();
631                for (Pair<AstClafer, Integer> offset : offsets) {
632                    for (AstConcreteClafer child : analysis.getBreakableChildren(offset.getFst())) {
633                        childIndex.addAll(Arrays.asList(indices.get(child)[i + offset.getSnd()]));
634                    }
635                }
636                if (ref != null && analysis.isBreakableRef(ref)) {
637                    breakableRefIds[i] = analysis.isBreakableRefId(ref, i + refOffset);
638                    if (ref.getTargetType() instanceof AstStringClafer) {
639                        childIndex.addAll(Arrays.asList(IrUtil.pad(
640                                refStrings.get(clafer)[i].getCharVars(),
641                                analysis.getScope().getStringLength())));
642                        if (ref.isUnique()) {
643                            childIndex.add(members[i]);
644                        }
645                    } else {
646                        // References need a positive weight, so to use their value as
647                        // a weight, need to offset it so that it always positive.
648                        childIndex.add(
649                                breakableRefIds[i]
650                                        // The id of the target is the weight.
651                                        ? minus(refPointers.get(clafer)[i])
652                                        // If analysis says that this id does not need breaking
653                                        // then give it a constant weight. Any constant is fine.
654                                        : Zero);
655                    }
656                }
657                if (analysis.isInheritedBreakableTarget(clafer)) {
658                    for (Pair<AstClafer, Integer> hierarchy : analysis.getHierarcyIds(clafer, i)) {
659                        for (AstRef sourceRef : analysis.getBreakableTarget(hierarchy.getFst())) {
660                            IrIntVar[] sourceRefs = refPointers.get(sourceRef.getSourceType());
661
662                            IrIntExpr[] array = new IrIntExpr[sourceRefs.length];
663                            System.arraycopy(sourceRefs, 0, array, 0, array.length);
664                            IrIntExpr count = count(hierarchy.getSnd().intValue(), array(array));
665                            IrIntVar countVar = domainInt("CountVar" + countCount++, count.getDomain());
666                            module.addConstraint(equal(countVar, count));
667                            childIndex.add(countVar);
668                        }
669                    }
670                }
671                childIndices[i] = childIndex.toArray(new IrIntExpr[childIndex.size()]);
672            }
673            for (int i = 0; i < weight.length; i++) {
674                weight[i]
675                        = childIndices[i].length == 0 ? Zero
676                                : boundInt(clafer.getName() + "#" + i + "@Weight", 0, scope - 1);
677            }
678            if (getScope(clafer.getParent()) > 1) {
679                module.addConstraint(sortChannel(childIndices, weight));
680                IrIntVar[] bounds = siblingBounds.get(clafer);
681                for (int i = 0; i < siblingSet.length; i++) {
682                    assert index[i].length <= weight.length;
683                    IrIntExpr bound;
684                    if (i == 0) {
685                        bound = Zero;
686                    } else if (bounds == null) {
687                        Card card = getCard(clafer);
688                        assert card.isExact();
689                        assert getFormat(clafer).equals(Format.ParentGroup);
690                        bound = mul(members[i], card.getLow() * i, enumDomain(0, card.getLow() * i));
691                    } else {
692                        bound = bounds[i - 1];
693                    }
694                    int start = index[i].length;
695                    IrIntExpr[] indexTo = Arrays.copyOf(index[i], weight.length + 1);
696                    for (int j = start; j < indexTo.length; j++) {
697                        indexTo[j] = constant(-1);
698                    }
699                    IrIntExpr[] weightTo = Arrays.copyOf(weight, weight.length + 1);
700                    weightTo[weight.length] = constant(-1);
701                    module.addConstraint(equal(
702                            array(indexTo),
703                            subarray(array(weightTo), bound, card(siblingSet[i]))));
704                }
705            }
706            if (getCard(clafer).getHigh() > 1) {
707                assert parents.length > 1;
708                if (parents.length > 1) {
709                    /**
710                     * What is this optimization?
711                     *
712                     * Force the lower number atoms to choose lower number
713                     * parents. For example consider the following Clafer model:
714                     *
715                     * <pre>
716                     * Person 2
717                     *     Hand 2
718                     * </pre>
719                     *
720                     * The constraint forbids the case where Hand0 belongs to
721                     * Person1 and Hand1 belongs to Person0. Otherwise, the
722                     * children can swap around creating many isomorphic
723                     * solutions.
724                     */
725                    if (ref != null && analysis.isBreakableRef(ref) && ref.isUnique()) {
726                        IrIntExpr[][] parentChildIndices = new IrIntExpr[childIndices.length][];
727                        for (int i = 0; i < parentChildIndices.length; i++) {
728                            parentChildIndices[i] = new IrIntExpr[childIndices[i].length + 2];
729                            parentChildIndices[i][0] = parents[i];
730                            for (int j = 1; j < parentChildIndices[i].length - 1; j++) {
731                                parentChildIndices[i][j] = minus(childIndices[i][j - 1]);
732                            }
733                            parentChildIndices[i][parentChildIndices[i].length - 1] = mul(not(members[i]), i, enumDomain(0, i));
734                        }
735                        // Refs are unique and part of the weight. It is impossible for
736                        // two weights to be the same. Enforce a strict order.
737                        module.addConstraint(sortStrict(parentChildIndices));
738                        if (getScope(clafer.getParent()) > 1) {
739                            IrIntExpr[][] parentChildWeights = new IrIntExpr[parents.length][3];
740                            for (int i = 0; i < parentChildWeights.length; i++) {
741                                parentChildWeights[i][0] = parents[i];
742                                parentChildWeights[i][1] = minus(weight[i]);
743                                parentChildWeights[i][2] = mul(not(members[i]), i, enumDomain(0, i));
744                            }
745                            module.addConstraint(sortStrict(parentChildWeights));
746                        }
747                    } else {
748                        IrIntExpr[][] parentChildIndices = new IrIntExpr[childIndices.length][];
749                        for (int i = 0; i < parentChildIndices.length; i++) {
750                            parentChildIndices[i] = new IrIntExpr[childIndices[i].length + 1];
751                            parentChildIndices[i][0] = parents[i];
752                            for (int j = 1; j < parentChildIndices[i].length; j++) {
753                                parentChildIndices[i][j] = minus(childIndices[i][j - 1]);
754                            }
755                        }
756                        module.addConstraint(sort(parentChildIndices));
757                        if (getScope(clafer.getParent()) > 1) {
758                            IrIntExpr[][] parentChildWeights = new IrIntExpr[parents.length][2];
759                            for (int i = 0; i < parentChildWeights.length; i++) {
760                                parentChildWeights[i][0] = parents[i];
761                                parentChildWeights[i][1] = minus(weight[i]);
762                            }
763                            module.addConstraint(sort(parentChildWeights));
764                        }
765                    }
766                }
767                for (int i = 0; i < parents.length - 1; i++) {
768                    if (ref != null && analysis.isBreakableRef(ref) && ref.isUnique()) {
769                        assert childIndices[i + 1].length == childIndices[i].length;
770                        if (breakableRefIds[i]) {
771                            if (refPartitions == null) {
772                                refPartitions = new DisjointSets<>();
773                            }
774                            refPartitions.union(i, i + 1);
775                        }
776                    }
777                }
778            }
779        }
780
781        if (ref != null) {
782            AstClafer tar = ref.getTargetType();
783            if (tar instanceof AstStringClafer) {
784                IrStringVar[] strings = refStrings.get(clafer);
785                if (ref.isUnique()) {
786                    if (getCard(clafer).getHigh() > 1) {
787                        for (int i = 0; i < strings.length - 1; i++) {
788                            for (int j = i + 1; j < strings.length; j++) {
789                                if (refPartitions == null || !refPartitions.connected(i, j)) {
790                                    module.addConstraint(
791                                            implies(and(members[i], members[j], greaterThanEqual(parents[i], parents[j])),
792                                                    notEqual(strings[i], strings[j])));
793                                }
794                            }
795                        }
796                    }
797                }
798                assert strings.length == members.length;
799                for (int i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
800                    module.addConstraint(implies(not(members[i]), equal(strings[i], EmptyString)));
801                }
802            } else {
803                IrIntVar[] refs = refPointers.get(clafer);
804                if (ref.isUnique()) {
805                    if (getCard(clafer).getHigh() > 1) {
806                        for (int i = 0; i < refs.length - 1; i++) {
807                            for (int j = i + 1; j < refs.length; j++) {
808                                if (refPartitions == null || !refPartitions.connected(i, j)) {
809                                    module.addConstraint(
810                                            implies(and(members[i], greaterThanEqual(parents[i], parents[j])),
811                                                    notEqual(refs[i], refs[j])));
812                                }
813                            }
814                        }
815                    }
816                    IrIntExpr size
817                            = ref.getTargetType() instanceof AstIntClafer
818                                    ? constant(analysis.getScope().getIntHigh() - analysis.getScope().getIntLow() + 1)
819                                    : ref.getTargetType() instanceof AstDecimalClafer
820                                            ? constant(analysis.getScope().getDecimalHigh() - analysis.getScope().getDecimalLow() + 1)
821                                            : card(sets.get(ref.getTargetType()));
822                    for (IrSetExpr sibling : siblingSet) {
823                        module.addConstraint(lessThanEqual(card(sibling), size));
824                    }
825                }
826                assert refs.length == members.length;
827                for (int i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
828                    // The ref pointers must point to the special uninitialized value
829                    // if the Clafer owning the ref pointers does not exists.
830                    module.addConstraint(ifOnlyIf(not(members[i]), equal(refs[i], getUninitalizedRef(tar))));
831                }
832                if (!ref.getTargetType().isPrimitive()) {
833                    IrSetVar targetSet = sets.get(ref.getTargetType());
834                    for (int i = 0; i < refs.length; i++) {
835                        // The ref pointers must point to a target that exists.
836                        if (getFormat(ref.getTargetType()).equals(Format.LowGroup)) {
837                            module.addConstraint(ifOnlyIf(members[i], lessThan(refs[i], card(targetSet))));
838                        } else {
839                            module.addConstraint(ifOnlyIf(members[i], member(refs[i], targetSet)));
840                        }
841                    }
842                }
843            }
844        }
845
846        switch (getFormat(clafer)) {
847            case LowGroup:
848                constrainLowGroupConcrete(clafer);
849                break;
850            case ParentGroup:
851                constrainParentGroupConcrete(clafer);
852                break;
853            default:
854                throw new AstException();
855        }
856
857        constrainGroupCardinality(clafer);
858
859        AstClafer inverse = analysis.getInverse(clafer);
860        if (inverse != null) {
861            int uninitializedRef = getUninitalizedRef(inverse.getRef().getTargetType());
862            IrIntVar[] inverseRefPointers = refPointers.get(inverse);
863            module.addConstraint(equal(countNotEqual(uninitializedRef, array(inverseRefPointers)), card(sets.get(clafer))));
864            for (int i = 0; i < siblingSet.length; i++) {
865                module.addConstraint(equal(count(i, array(inverseRefPointers)), card(siblingSet[i])));
866            }
867            module.addConstraint(equal(card(sets.get(clafer)), card(sets.get(inverse))));
868        }
869    }
870
871    private void constrainGroupCardinality(AstConcreteClafer clafer) {
872        Card groupCard = AstUtil.getInheritedGroupCard(clafer);
873
874        if (groupCard != null && groupCard.isBounded()) {
875            int scope = getScope(clafer);
876            IrBoolExpr[] members = memberships.get(clafer);
877            AstClafer curClafer = clafer;
878            List<IrIntExpr>[] cards = new List[scope];
879            assert cards.length == members.length;
880            for (int i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
881                cards[i] = new ArrayList<>();
882            }
883            do {
884                List<AstConcreteClafer> children = curClafer.getChildren();
885                if (!children.isEmpty()) {
886                    int offset = getOffset(curClafer, clafer);
887                    IrSetVar[][] childrenSets = new IrSetVar[children.size()][];
888                    for (int i = 0; i < childrenSets.length; i++) {
889                        AstConcreteClafer child = children.get(i);
890                        childrenSets[i] = siblingSets.get(child);
891                    }
892                    for (int i = 0; i < scope; i++) {
893                        for (IrSetVar[] childrenSet : childrenSets) {
894                            cards[i].add(card(childrenSet[i + offset]));
895                        }
896                    }
897                }
898            } while ((curClafer = curClafer.getSuperClafer()) != null);
899
900            for (int i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
901                if (!cards[i].isEmpty()) {
902                    module.addConstraint(implies(members[i], constrainCard(add(cards[i]), groupCard)));
903                }
904            }
905        }
906    }
907
908    private void initLowGroupConcrete(AstConcreteClafer clafer) {
909        PartialSolution partialSolution = getPartialSolution(clafer);
910
911        IrSetVar[] childSet = buildChildSet(clafer);
912        siblingSets.put(clafer, childSet);
913
914        IrBoolVar[] members = new IrBoolVar[getScope(clafer)];
915        for (int i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
916            if (partialSolution.hasClafer(i)) {
917                members[i] = True;
918            } else {
919                members[i] = bool(clafer.getName() + "@Membership#" + i);
920                if (childSet.length == 1 && members.length == 1) {
921                    module.addConstraint(equal(members[i], card(childSet[0])));
922                }
923            }
924        }
925        Check.noNulls(members);
926        memberships.put(clafer, members);
927
928        IrIntVar[] bounds = new IrIntVar[childSet.length];
929        for (int i = 0; i < bounds.length; i++) {
930            bounds[i] = boundInt("bounds" + clafer.getName() + "#" + i, 0, members.length);
931        }
932        siblingBounds.put(clafer, bounds);
933    }
934
935    private void constrainLowGroupConcrete(AstConcreteClafer clafer) {
936        IrBoolExpr[] members = memberships.get(clafer);
937        IrSetVar set = sets.get(clafer);
938
939        IrBoolExpr[] parentMembership = memberships.get(clafer.getParent());
940        Card card = getCard(clafer);
941        IrSetVar[] childSet = siblingSets.get(clafer);
942
943        if (fullSymmetryBreaking) {
944            module.addConstraint(selectN(members, card(set)));
945            IrIntExpr[] bounds = siblingBounds.get(clafer);
946            if (childSet.length > 1) {
947                module.addConstraint(sort(childSet, bounds));
948            }
949        }
950
951        for (int i = 0; i < parentMembership.length; i++) {
952            IrBoolExpr parentMember = parentMembership[i];
953            if (card.isBounded()) {
954                // Enforce cardinality.
955                module.addConstraint(implies(parentMember, constrainCard(card(childSet[i]), card)));
956            }
957            module.addConstraint(implies(not(parentMember), equal(childSet[i], EmptySet)));
958        }
959
960        if (!(childSet.length == 1 && members.length == 1)) {
961            module.addConstraint(boolChannel(members, set));
962        }
963    }
964
965    private void initParentGroupConcrete(AstConcreteClafer clafer) {
966        PartialSolution partialParentSolution = getPartialParentSolution(clafer);
967
968        IrSetVar[] children = new IrSetVar[partialParentSolution.size()];
969        Card card = getCard(clafer);
970        assert card.getLow() == card.getHigh();
971        int lowCard = card.getLow();
972        for (int i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
973            if (lowCard == 0) {
974                children[i] = EmptySet;
975            } else if (partialParentSolution.hasClafer(i)) {
976                children[i] = constant(Util.fromTo(i * lowCard, i * lowCard + lowCard));
977            } else {
978                children[i] = set(clafer.getName() + "#" + i,
979                        boundDomain(i * lowCard, i * lowCard + lowCard - 1),
980                        EmptyDomain,
981                        enumDomain(0, lowCard));
982            }
983        }
984
985        siblingSets.put(clafer, children);
986
987        IrBoolVar[] members = new IrBoolVar[getScope(clafer)];
988        IrBoolVar[] parentMembership = memberships.get(clafer.getParent());
989        if (lowCard == 1) {
990            if (members.length == parentMembership.length) {
991                members = parentMembership;
992            } else {
993                System.arraycopy(parentMembership, 0, members, 0, parentMembership.length);
994                Arrays.fill(members, parentMembership.length, members.length, False);
995            }
996        } else {
997            for (int i = 0; i < parentMembership.length; i++) {
998                for (int j = 0; j < lowCard; j++) {
999                    members[i * lowCard + j] = parentMembership[i];
1000                }
1001            }
1002            Arrays.fill(members, parentMembership.length * lowCard, members.length, False);
1003        }
1004        Check.noNulls(members);
1005        memberships.put(clafer, members);
1006    }
1007
1008    private void constrainParentGroupConcrete(AstConcreteClafer clafer) {
1009        PartialSolution partialParentSolution = getPartialParentSolution(clafer);
1010
1011        IrSetVar[] children = siblingSets.get(clafer);
1012        assert getCard(clafer).getLow() == getCard(clafer).getHigh();
1013        int lowCard = getCard(clafer).getLow();
1014        for (int i = 0; i < children.length; i++) {
1015            if (!partialParentSolution.hasClafer(i)) {
1016                if (lowCard == 1) {
1017                    module.addConstraint(equal(memberships.get(clafer.getParent())[i],
1018                            card(children[i])));
1019                }
1020                module.addConstraint(implies(memberships.get(clafer.getParent())[i],
1021                        equal(children[i], constant(Util.fromTo(i * lowCard, i * lowCard + lowCard)))));
1022                module.addConstraint(implies(not(memberships.get(clafer.getParent())[i]),
1023                        equal(children[i], EmptySet)));
1024
1025            }
1026        }
1027    }
1028
1029    private void initAbstract(AstAbstractClafer clafer) {
1030        IrSetVar[] subSets = new IrSetVar[clafer.getSubs().size()];
1031        IrBoolVar[] members = new IrBoolVar[getScope(clafer)];
1032        for (int i = 0; i < subSets.length; i++) {
1033            AstClafer sub = clafer.getSubs().get(i);
1034            subSets[i] = sets.get(sub);
1035            IrBoolVar[] subMembers = memberships.get(sub);
1036            int offset = getOffset(clafer, sub);
1037            for (int j = 0; j < subMembers.length; j++) {
1038                assert members[offset + j] == null;
1039                members[offset + j] = Check.notNull(subMembers[j]);
1040            }
1041        }
1042        if (subSets.length == 1) {
1043            sets.put(clafer, sets.get(clafer.getSubs().get(0)));
1044        } else {
1045            TIntArrayList env = new TIntArrayList();
1046            TIntArrayList ker = new TIntArrayList();
1047            for (int i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
1048                if (members[i].getDomain().isTrue()) {
1049                    ker.add(i);
1050                }
1051                if (!members[i].getDomain().isFalse()) {
1052                    env.add(i);
1053                }
1054            }
1055            IrSetVar unionSet = set(clafer.getName(), env.toArray(), ker.toArray());
1056            if (!AstUtil.isTypeRoot(clafer)) {
1057                module.addConstraint(boolChannel(members, unionSet));
1058            }
1059            sets.put(clafer, unionSet);
1060        }
1061        Check.noNulls(members);
1062        memberships.put(clafer, members);
1063
1064        AstRef ref = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(clafer);
1065        if (ref != null) {
1066            if (ref.getTargetType() instanceof AstStringClafer) {
1067                IrStringVar[] refs = new IrStringVar[members.length];
1068                for (AstClafer sub : clafer.getSubs()) {
1069                    IrStringVar[] subRef = refStrings.get(sub);
1070                    int offset = getOffset(clafer, sub);
1071                    System.arraycopy(subRef, 0, refs, offset, subRef.length);
1072                }
1073                refStrings.put(clafer, refs);
1074            } else {
1075                IrIntVar[] refs = new IrIntVar[members.length];
1076                for (AstClafer sub : clafer.getSubs()) {
1077                    IrIntVar[] subRef = refPointers.get(sub);
1078                    // a sub clafer that refines the reference to a subtype of the target points
1079                    // into the subtype; this clafer's pointers point into the target
1080                    AstClafer subTarget = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(sub).getTargetType();
1081                    if (!subTarget.equals(ref.getTargetType()) && !subTarget.isPrimitive()) {
1082                        subRef = retargetRefPointers(subRef, subTarget, ref.getTargetType());
1083                    }
1084                    int offset = getOffset(clafer, sub);
1085                    System.arraycopy(subRef, 0, refs, offset, subRef.length);
1086                }
1087                refPointers.put(clafer, refs);
1088            }
1089        }
1090
1091        if (!AstUtil.isTop(clafer) && !AstUtil.isTypeRoot(clafer)) {
1092            IrIntVar[] parentPointer = new IrIntVar[members.length];
1093            IrSetVar[] siblingSet = new IrSetVar[getScope(clafer.getParent())];
1094            List<IrSetExpr>[] unions = new List[siblingSet.length];
1095            for (int i = 0; i < unions.length; i++) {
1096                unions[i] = new ArrayList<>();
1097            }
1098            for (AstClafer sub : clafer.getSubs()) {
1099                int offset = getOffset(clafer, sub);
1100                int parentOffset = getOffset(clafer.getParent(), sub.getParent());
1101
1102                IrIntVar[] subParentPointer = parentPointers.get(sub);
1103                for (int i = 0; i < subParentPointer.length; i++) {
1104                    IrIntExpr parentExpr = add(subParentPointer[i], parentOffset);
1105                    IrIntVar parentVar = domainInt(clafer + "@Parent#" + i, parentExpr.getDomain());
1106                    module.addConstraint(equal(parentVar, parentExpr));
1107                    assert parentPointer[i + offset] == null;
1108                    parentPointer[i + offset] = parentVar;
1109                }
1110
1111                IrSetVar[] subSiblingSet = siblingSets.get(sub);
1112                for (int i = 0; i < subSiblingSet.length; i++) {
1113                    unions[i + parentOffset].add(offset(subSiblingSet[i], offset));
1114                }
1115            }
1116            for (int i = 0; i < siblingSet.length; i++) {
1117                IrSetExpr union = unionDisjoint(unions[i].toArray(new IrSetExpr[unions[i].size()]));
1118                siblingSet[i] = set(clafer.getName() + "#" + i,
1119                        union.getEnv(), union.getKer(), union.getCard());
1120                module.addConstraint(equal(siblingSet[i], union));
1121            }
1122            parentPointers.put(clafer, parentPointer);
1123            siblingSets.put(clafer, siblingSet);
1124        }
1125    }

1128        // Do nothing.
1129    }

1153        private IrExpr compile(AstExpr expr) {
1154            return switch (expr) {
1155                case AstArithm e -> visit(e);
1156                case AstBoolArithm e -> visit(e);
1157                case AstCard e -> visit(e);
1158                case AstChildRelation e -> visit(e);
1159                case AstCompare e -> visit(e);
1160                case AstConcat e -> visit(e);
1161                case AstConnected e -> visit(e);
1162                case AstConstant e -> visit(e);
1163                case AstDecimalConstant e -> visit(e);
1164                case AstDifference e -> visit(e);
1165                case AstDomainRestriction e -> visit(e);
1166                case AstDowncast e -> visit(e);
1167                case AstGlobal e -> visit(e);
1168                case AstIfThenElse e -> visit(e);
1169                case AstIntersection e -> visit(e);
1170                case AstInverse e -> visit(e);
1171                case AstJoin e -> visit(e);
1172                case AstJoinParent e -> visit(e);
1173                case AstJoinRef e -> visit(e);
1174                case AstLength e -> visit(e);
1175                case AstLocal e -> visit(e);
1176                case AstMax e -> visit(e);
1177                case AstMembership e -> visit(e);
1178                case AstMin e -> visit(e);
1179                case AstMinus e -> visit(e);
1180                case AstMod e -> visit(e);
1181                case AstNot e -> visit(e);
1182                case AstParentRelation e -> visit(e);
1183                case AstPrefix e -> visit(e);
1184                case AstProduct e -> visit(e);
1185                case AstQuantify e -> visit(e);
1186                case AstRangeRestriction e -> visit(e);
1187                case AstRefRelation e -> visit(e);
1188                case AstSetTest e -> visit(e);
1189                case AstStringConstant e -> visit(e);
1190                case AstSuffix e -> visit(e);
1191                case AstSum e -> visit(e);
1192                case AstTernary e -> visit(e);
1193                case AstThis e -> visit(e);
1194                case AstTransitiveClosure e -> visit(e);
1195                case AstUnion e -> visit(e);
1196                case AstUpcast e -> visit(e);
1197            };
1198        }

1316        private IrExpr visit(AstJoin ast) {
1317            IrExpr left = compile(ast.left());
1318            if (ast.right() instanceof AstChildRelation) {
1319                return doJoin(left, ((AstChildRelation) ast.right()).childType());
1320            }
1321            IrExpr right = compile(ast.right());
1322            if (right instanceof IrIntArrayExpr) {
1323                IrIntArrayExpr rightArray = (IrIntArrayExpr) right;
1324                if (left instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1325                    IrIntExpr uninitialized = constant(getUninitalizedRef(getType(ast).getClaferType()));
1326                    // Why uninitialized? The left expression can contain unused.
1327                    return element(snoc(rightArray, uninitialized), (IrIntExpr) left);
1328                } else if (left instanceof IrSetExpr) {
1329                    IrIntExpr uninitialized = constant(getUninitalizedRef(getType(ast).getClaferType()));
1330                    // Why uninitialized? The left expression can contain unused.
1331                    return joinFunction((IrSetExpr) left, snoc(rightArray, uninitialized), null);
1332                } else if (left instanceof IrIntArrayExpr) {
1333                    IrIntExpr uninitialized = constant(getUninitalizedRef(getType(ast).getCommonSupertype().get(1)));
1334                    // Why uninitialized? The left expression can contain unused.
1335                    IrIntArrayExpr leftArray = (IrIntArrayExpr) left;
1336                    rightArray = snoc(rightArray, uninitialized);
1337                    IrIntExpr[] join = new IrIntExpr[leftArray.length()];
1338                    for (int i = 0; i < join.length; i++) {
1339                        join[i] = element(rightArray, get(leftArray, i));
1340                    }
1341                    return array(join);
1342                } else if (left instanceof IrSetArrayExpr) {
1343                    IrIntExpr uninitialized = constant(getUninitalizedRef(getType(ast).getCommonSupertype().get(1)));
1344                    // Why uninitialized? The left expression can contain unused.
1345                    IrSetArrayExpr leftArray = (IrSetArrayExpr) left;
1346                    rightArray = snoc(rightArray, uninitialized);
1347                    IrSetExpr[] join = new IrSetExpr[leftArray.length()];
1348                    for (int i = 0; i < join.length; i++) {
1349                        // TODO global cardinality?
1350                        join[i] = joinFunction(get(leftArray, i), rightArray, null);
1351
1352                    }
1353                    return array(join);
1354                }
1355            } else if (right instanceof IrSetArrayExpr) {
1356                // Why empty set? The left expression can contain unused.
1357                IrSetArrayExpr rightArray = snoc((IrSetArrayExpr) right, EmptySet);
1358                if (left instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1359                    // TODO which relations are injective?
1360                    return element(rightArray, (IrIntExpr) left);
1361                } else if (left instanceof IrSetExpr) {
1362                    // TODO which relations are injective?
1363                    return joinRelation((IrSetExpr) left, rightArray, false);
1364                } else if (left instanceof IrIntArrayExpr) {
1365                    IrIntArrayExpr leftArray = (IrIntArrayExpr) left;
1366                    IrSetExpr[] join = new IrSetExpr[leftArray.length()];
1367                    for (int i = 0; i < join.length; i++) {
1368                        // TODO which relations are injective?
1369                        join[i] = element(rightArray, get(leftArray, i));
1370                    }
1371                    return array(join);
1372                } else if (left instanceof IrSetArrayExpr) {
1373                    IrSetArrayExpr leftArray = ((IrSetArrayExpr) left);
1374                    IrSetExpr[] join = new IrSetExpr[leftArray.length()];
1375                    for (int i = 0; i < join.length; i++) {
1376                        // TODO which relations are injective?
1377                        join[i] = joinRelation(get(leftArray, i), rightArray, false);
1378                    }
1379                    return array(join);
1380                }
1381            }
1382            throw new AstException();
1383        }

1385        private IrExpr doJoin(IrExpr left, AstClafer right) {
1386            IrSetArrayExpr rightArray;
1387            if (right instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
1388                // Why empty set? The "take" var can contain unused.
1389                rightArray = snoc(array(siblingSets.get(right)), EmptySet);
1390            } else {
1391                AstAbstractClafer abstractRight = (AstAbstractClafer) right;
1392                IrSetExpr[] array = new IrSetExpr[getScope(right.getParent())];
1393                Arrays.fill(array, EmptySet);
1394                for (AstClafer sub : abstractRight.getSubs()) {
1395                    int offset = getOffset(abstractRight, sub);
1396                    int parentOffset = getOffset(abstractRight.getParent(), sub.getParent());
1397                    IrSetVar[] subSiblingSet = siblingSets.get(sub);
1398                    for (int i = 0; i < subSiblingSet.length; i++) {
1399                        array[i + parentOffset] = unionDisjoint(array[i + parentOffset],
1400                                offset(subSiblingSet[i], offset));
1401                    }
1402                }
1403                // Why empty set? The "take" var can contain unused, as for a concrete clafer.
1404                rightArray = snoc(array(array), EmptySet);
1405            }
1406            if (left instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1407                IrIntExpr $intLeft = (IrIntExpr) left;
1408                if (Format.ParentGroup.equals(getFormat(right)) && right instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
1409                    Card card = getCard((AstConcreteClafer) right);
1410                    if (card.getLow() == 1) {
1411                        assert card.isExact();
1412                        return $intLeft;
1413                    }
1414                }
1415                return element(rightArray, $intLeft);
1416            } else if (left instanceof IrSetExpr) {
1417                IrSetExpr $setLeft = (IrSetExpr) left;
1418                return joinRelation($setLeft, rightArray, true);
1419            } else if (left instanceof IrIntArrayExpr) {
1420                IrIntArrayExpr leftArray = (IrIntArrayExpr) left;
1421                IrSetExpr[] join = new IrSetExpr[leftArray.length()];
1422                for (int i = 0; i < join.length; i++) {
1423                    // TODO which relations are injective?
1424                    join[i] = element(rightArray, get(leftArray, i));
1425                }
1426                return array(join);
1427            } else if (left instanceof IrSetArrayExpr) {
1428                IrSetArrayExpr leftArray = ((IrSetArrayExpr) left);
1429                IrSetExpr[] join = new IrSetExpr[leftArray.length()];
1430                for (int i = 0; i < join.length; i++) {
1431                    join[i] = joinRelation(get(leftArray, i), rightArray, true);
1432                }
1433                return array(join);
1434            }
1435            throw new AstException();
1436        }

1438        private IrExpr visit(AstJoinParent ast) {
1439            AstClafer childrenType = getCommonSupertype(ast.children()).getClaferType();
1440
1441            IrExpr children = compile(ast.children());
1442            if (children instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1443                IrIntExpr intChildren = (IrIntExpr) children;
1444                switch (getFormat(childrenType)) {
1445                    case ParentGroup:
1446                        if (childrenType instanceof AstConcreteClafer) {
1447                            Card card = getCard((AstConcreteClafer) childrenType);
1448                            assert card.isExact();
1449                            return div(intChildren, card.getLow());
1450                        }
1451                    // fallthrough
1452                    case LowGroup:
1453                        IrIntVar[] parents = parentPointers.get(childrenType);
1454                        if (intChildren.getHighBound() >= parents.length) {
1455                            // an unused child has no parent: the parent pointer of an unused child
1456                            parents = Util.snoc(parents, constant(getScope(childrenType.getParent())));
1457                        }
1458                        return element(parents, intChildren);
1459                }
1460            } else if (children instanceof IrSetExpr) {
1461                IrSetExpr setChildren = (IrSetExpr) children;
1462                if (setChildren.getEnv().isEmpty()) {
1463                    // e.g., `this` of an abstract clafer downcast to another subclafer
1464                    return EmptySet;
1465                }
1466                IrIntVar[] parents = parentPointers.get(childrenType);
1467                if (setChildren.getEnv().getHighBound() >= parents.length) {
1468                    // an unused child has no parent: the parent pointer of an unused child
1469                    parents = Util.snoc(parents, constant(getScope(childrenType.getParent())));
1470                }
1471                return joinFunction(setChildren, parents, null);
1472            }
1473            throw new AstException();
1474        }

1476        private IrExpr visit(AstJoinRef ast) {
1477            AstSetExpr deref = ast.deref();
1478            AstClafer derefType = getCommonSupertype(deref).getClaferType();
1479
1480            Integer globalCardinality = null;
1481            IrExpr $deref = null;
1482            if (derefType.getRef().isUnique()) {
1483                if (deref instanceof AstJoin) {
1484                    AstJoin join = (AstJoin) deref;
1485                    if (join.right() instanceof AstChildRelation) {
1486                        IrExpr left = compile(join.left());
1487                        $deref = doJoin(left, ((AstChildRelation) join.right()).childType());
1488
1489                        globalCardinality = left instanceof IrSetExpr
1490                                ? ((IrSetExpr) left).getCard().getHighBound()
1491                                : 1;
1492                        globalCardinality *= AstUtil.getConcreteSubs(derefType).size();
1493                    }
1494                }
1495                if ($deref == null) {
1496                    $deref = compile(deref);
1497                    globalCardinality = AstUtil.getConcreteSubs(derefType).stream()
1498                            .map(AstConcreteClafer::getParent)
1499                            .mapToInt(AstCompiler.this::getScope).sum();
1500                }
1501            } else {
1502                $deref = compile(deref);
1503            }
1504
1505            AstRef ref = derefType.getRef();
1506            if (ref.getTargetType() instanceof AstStringClafer) {
1507                return derefString(ref, $deref, ast);
1508            }
1509            if ($deref instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1510                // Why zero? The "take" var can contain unused.
1511                return element(Util.snoc(refPointers.get(ref.getSourceType()), Zero), (IrIntExpr) $deref);
1512            } else if ($deref instanceof IrSetExpr) {
1513                // Why zero? The "take" var can contain unused.
1514                return joinFunction((IrSetExpr) $deref, Util.snoc(refPointers.get(ref.getSourceType()), Zero), globalCardinality);
1515            }
1516            throw new AstException();
1517        }

1519        /*
1520         * The string of a string reference joined over at most one clafer. A set of strings is
1521         * only supported as an operand of a comparison (compileComparand).
1522         */
1523        private IrStringExpr derefString(AstRef ref, IrExpr $deref, AstJoinRef ast) {
1524            // Why empty string? The "take" var can contain unused.
1525            IrStringExpr[] refs = Util.snoc(refStrings.get(ref.getSourceType()), EmptyString);
1526            if ($deref instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1527                return element(refs, (IrIntExpr) $deref);
1528            } else if ($deref instanceof IrSetExpr) {
1529                IrSetExpr $setDeref = (IrSetExpr) $deref;
1530                if ($setDeref.getCard().getHighBound() == 1) {
1531                    return element(refs, max($setDeref, refs.length - 1));
1532                }
1533                throw new JoinSetWithStringException(ast, $setDeref.getCard());
1534            }
1535            throw new AstException();
1536        }

1538        private IrExpr visit(AstCard ast) {
1539            IrExpr set = compile(ast.set());
1540            if (set instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1541                return One;
1542            } else if (set instanceof IrSetExpr) {
1543                return card((IrSetExpr) set);
1544            } else if (set instanceof IrIntArrayExpr) {
1545                IrIntArrayExpr array = (IrIntArrayExpr) set;
1546                Type type = getType(ast.set());
1547                assert type.getCommonSupertype().arity() == 2;
1548                return countNotEqual(getUninitalizedRef(type.getCommonSupertype().get(1)), array);
1549            }
1550            IrSetArrayExpr array = ((IrSetArrayExpr) set);
1551            IrIntExpr[] cards = new IrIntExpr[array.length()];
1552            for (int i = 0; i < cards.length; i++) {
1553                cards[i] = card(get(array, i));
1554            }
1555            return add(cards);
1556        }

1582        /*
1583         * A set of strings, e.g. names.ref for names -> string 2: each string with whether it
1584         * is in the set. Choco has no sets of strings, so a comparison of sets of strings is
1585         * compiled string by string (https://github.com/gsdlab/chocosolver/issues/49).
1586         */
1587        private record StringSet(IrBoolExpr[] members, IrStringExpr[] strings) {
1588
1589            static StringSet of(IrStringExpr string) {
1590                return new StringSet(new IrBoolExpr[]{True}, new IrStringExpr[]{string});
1591            }
1592
1593            /*
1594             * Every string of this set is in the other set.
1595             */
1596            IrBoolExpr subsetEq(StringSet other) {
1597                IrBoolExpr[] subset = new IrBoolExpr[strings.length];
1598                for (int i = 0; i < strings.length; i++) {
1599                    IrBoolExpr[] in = new IrBoolExpr[other.strings.length];
1600                    for (int j = 0; j < in.length; j++) {
1601                        in[j] = and(other.members[j], equal(strings[i], other.strings[j]));
1602                    }
1603                    subset[i] = implies(members[i], or(in));
1604                }
1605                return and(subset);
1606            }
1607        }

1609        /*
1610         * The operand of a comparison: a set of strings if it is the join of a string
1611         * reference over a set that can have more than one element, otherwise as compiled.
1612         */
1613        private Object compileComparand(AstSetExpr ast) {
1614            if (ast instanceof AstJoinRef joinRef) {
1615                AstRef ref = getCommonSupertype(joinRef.deref()).getClaferType().getRef();
1616                if (ref != null && ref.getTargetType() instanceof AstStringClafer) {
1617                    IrExpr $deref = compile(joinRef.deref());
1618                    if ($deref instanceof IrSetExpr $setDeref && $setDeref.getCard().getHighBound() != 1) {
1619                        IrStringExpr[] refs = refStrings.get(ref.getSourceType());
1620                        int[] env = $setDeref.getEnv().getValues();
1621                        IrBoolExpr[] members = new IrBoolExpr[env.length];
1622                        IrStringExpr[] strings = new IrStringExpr[env.length];
1623                        for (int i = 0; i < env.length; i++) {
1624                            members[i] = member(constant(env[i]), $setDeref);
1625                            strings[i] = refs[env[i]];
1626                        }
1627                        return new StringSet(members, strings);
1628                    }
1629                    return derefString(ref, $deref, joinRef);
1630                }
1631            }
1632            return compile(ast);
1633        }

1635        private StringSet asStringSet(Object comparand) {
1636            return comparand instanceof StringSet stringSet
1637                    ? stringSet : StringSet.of((IrStringExpr) comparand);
1638        }

1640        private IrExpr visit(AstSetTest ast) {
1641            Object leftComparand = compileComparand(ast.left());
1642            Object rightComparand = compileComparand(ast.right());
1643            if (leftComparand instanceof StringSet || rightComparand instanceof StringSet) {
1644                StringSet leftSet = asStringSet(leftComparand);
1645                StringSet rightSet = asStringSet(rightComparand);
1646                IrBoolExpr equal = and(leftSet.subsetEq(rightSet), rightSet.subsetEq(leftSet));
1647                return AstSetTest.Op.Equal.equals(ast.op()) ? equal : not(equal);
1648            }
1649            IrExpr left = (IrExpr) leftComparand;
1650            IrExpr right = (IrExpr) rightComparand;
1651
1652            if (left instanceof IrIntExpr && right instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1653                IrIntExpr intLeft = (IrIntExpr) left;
1654                IrIntExpr intRight = (IrIntExpr) right;
1655                switch (ast.op()) {
1656                    case Equal:
1657                        return equal(intLeft, intRight);
1658                    case NotEqual:
1659                        return notEqual(intLeft, intRight);
1660                }
1661            }
1662
1663            if (left instanceof IrStringExpr && right instanceof IrStringExpr) {
1664                IrStringExpr stringLeft = (IrStringExpr) left;
1665                IrStringExpr stringRight = (IrStringExpr) right;
1666                switch (ast.op()) {
1667                    case Equal:
1668                        return equal(stringLeft, stringRight);
1669                    case NotEqual:
1670                        return notEqual(stringLeft, stringRight);
1671                }
1672            }
1673
1674            if (left instanceof IrIntArrayExpr) {
1675                IrIntArrayExpr leftArray = (IrIntArrayExpr) left;
1676                if (right instanceof IrIntArrayExpr) {
1677                    IrIntArrayExpr rightArray = (IrIntArrayExpr) right;
1678                    return equal(leftArray, rightArray);
1679                } else if (right instanceof IrSetArrayExpr) {
1680                    Type type = getType(ast.left());
1681                    AstClafer returnType = type.getCommonSupertype().get(1);
1682                    IrSetArrayExpr rightArray = (IrSetArrayExpr) right;
1683                    // TODO use asRelation
1684                    return equal(IrUtil.asArray(filterNotEqual(leftArray, getUninitalizedRef(returnType))), IrUtil.asArray(rightArray));
1685                }
1686            } else if (left instanceof IrSetArrayExpr) {
1687                IrSetArrayExpr leftArray = (IrSetArrayExpr) left;
1688                if (right instanceof IrIntArrayExpr) {
1689                    Type type = getType(ast.right());
1690                    AstClafer returnType = type.getCommonSupertype().get(1);
1691                    IrIntArrayExpr rightArray = (IrIntArrayExpr) right;
1692                    // TODO use asRelation
1693                    return equal(IrUtil.asArray(leftArray), IrUtil.asArray(filterNotEqual(rightArray, getUninitalizedRef(returnType))));
1694                } else if (right instanceof IrSetArrayExpr) {
1695                    IrSetArrayExpr rightArray = (IrSetArrayExpr) right;
1696                    return equal(IrUtil.asArray(leftArray), IrUtil.asArray(rightArray));
1697                }
1698            }
1699
1700            switch (ast.op()) {
1701                case Equal:
1702                    return equal(asSet(left), asSet(right));
1703                case NotEqual:
1704                    return notEqual(asSet(left), asSet(right));
1705                default:
1706                    throw new AstException();
1707            }
1708        }

1710        private IrExpr visit(AstCompare ast) {
1711            IrIntExpr left = asInt(compile(ast.left()));
1712            IrIntExpr right = asInt(compile(ast.right()));
1713            switch (ast.op()) {
1714                case LessThan:
1715                    return lessThan(left, right);
1716                case LessThanEqual:
1717                    return lessThanEqual(left, right);
1718                case GreaterThan:
1719                    return greaterThan(left, right);
1720                case GreaterThanEqual:
1721                    return greaterThanEqual(left, right);
1722                default:
1723                    throw new AstException();
1724            }
1725        }

1727        private IrExpr visit(AstArithm ast) {
1728            IrIntExpr[] operands = asInts(compile(ast.operands()));
1729            switch (ast.op()) {
1730                case Add:
1731                    return add(operands);
1732                case Sub:
1733                    return sub(operands);
1734                case Mul:
1735                    IrBoolVar member = memberships.get(thisType)[thisId];
1736                    // A decimal times an integer is limited by the range of decimals.
1737                    Domain mulRange = getType(ast).isDecimal() ? getDecimalRange() : getMulRange();
1738                    IrIntExpr product = operands[0];
1739                    for (int i = 1; i < operands.length; i++) {
1740                        IrIntExpr operand = operands[i];
1741                        Domain mulBoundDomain = mulBoundDomain(product.getDomain(), operand.getDomain());
1742                        if (!mulBoundDomain.isSubsetOf(mulRange)) {
1743                            operand = ternary(member, operands[i], Zero);
1744                        }
1745                        product = mul(product, operand, mulRange);
1746                    }
1747                    return product;
1748                case Div:
1749                    member = memberships.get(thisType)[thisId];
1750                    IrIntExpr quotient = operands[0];
1751                    for (int i = 1; i < operands.length; i++) {
1752                        IrIntExpr operand = operands[i];
1753                        quotient = div(quotient,
1754                                operand.getDomain().contains(0) ? ternary(member, operand, One) : operand);
1755                    }
1756                    return quotient;
1757                case DecimalMul:
1758                    IrIntExpr decimalProduct = operands[0];
1759                    for (int i = 1; i < operands.length; i++) {
1760                        decimalProduct = decimalArithm(IrDecimalArithm.Op.Mul, decimalProduct, operands[i],
1761                                getDecimalOne(), getDecimalRange());
1762                    }
1763                    return decimalProduct;
1764                case DecimalDiv:
1765                    member = memberships.get(thisType)[thisId];
1766                    IrIntExpr decimalQuotient = operands[0];
1767                    for (int i = 1; i < operands.length; i++) {
1768                        IrIntExpr operand = operands[i];
1769                        // The divisor is 1.0 where this Clafer does not exist.
1770                        decimalQuotient = decimalArithm(IrDecimalArithm.Op.Div, decimalQuotient,
1771                                operand.getDomain().contains(0) ? ternary(member, operand, constant(getDecimalOne())) : operand,
1772                                getDecimalOne(), getDecimalRange());
1773                    }
1774                    return decimalQuotient;
1775                default:
1776                    throw new AstException();
1777            }
1778        }

1780        private IrExpr visit(AstMod ast) {
1781            return mod(asInt(compile(ast.dividend())), asInt(compile(ast.divisor())));
1782        }

1784        private IrIntExpr concatRefs(AstSetExpr set, Monoid<IrIntExpr> monoid) {
1785            AstClafer setType = getCommonSupertype(set).getClaferType();
1786            assert setType.hasRef();
1787            IrIntVar[] refs = refPointers.get(setType);
1788            String name = monoid.getClass().getSimpleName();
1789            int count = concatRefsCount++;
1790
1791            IrBoolExpr[] members;
1792            if (set instanceof AstGlobal) {
1793                members = memberships.get(setType);
1794            } else {
1795                IrExpr $set = compile(set);
1796                if ($set instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1797                    IrIntExpr intSet = (IrIntExpr) $set;
1798                    return element(refs, intSet);
1799                }
1800                IrSetExpr setSet = (IrSetExpr) $set;
1801                if (setSet.getEnv().isEmpty()) {
1802                    return monoid.empty();
1803                }
1804                assert setSet.getEnv().getLowBound() >= 0;
1805                members = new IrBoolExpr[setSet.getEnv().getHighBound() + 1];
1806                for (int i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
1807                    members[i] = bool(name + "Member" + count + "@" + i);
1808                }
1809                module.addConstraint(boolChannel(members, setSet));
1810            }
1811            assert members.length <= refs.length;
1812
1813            IrIntVar[] score = new IrIntVar[members.length];
1814            for (int i = 0; i < members.length; i++) {
1815                Domain domain = refs[i].getDomain();
1816                int uninitializedRef = getUninitalizedRef(setType.getRef().getTargetType());
1817                IrIntExpr identity = monoid.empty();
1818                domain = domain.remove(uninitializedRef).union(identity.getDomain());
1819                score[i] = domainInt(name + count + "@" + i, domain);
1820                module.addConstraint(ifThenElse(members[i],
1821                        equal(score[i], refs[i]), equal(score[i], identity)));
1822            }
1823            return monoid.concat(score);
1824        }

1834        private IrExpr visit(AstBoolArithm ast) {
1835            IrBoolExpr[] operands = compile(ast.operands());
1836            switch (ast.op()) {
1837                case And:
1838                    return and(operands);
1839                case IfOnlyIf:
1840                    IrBoolExpr ifOnlyIf = operands[0];
1841                    for (int i = 1; i < operands.length; i++) {
1842                        ifOnlyIf = ifOnlyIf(ifOnlyIf, operands[i]);
1843                    }
1844                    return ifOnlyIf;
1845                case Implies:
1846                    IrBoolExpr implies = operands[0];
1847                    for (int i = 1; i < operands.length; i++) {
1848                        implies = implies(implies, operands[i]);
1849                    }
1850                    return implies;
1851                case Or:
1852                    return or(operands);
1853                case Xor:
1854                    IrBoolExpr xor = operands[0];
1855                    for (int i = 1; i < operands.length; i++) {
1856                        xor = xor(xor, operands[i]);
1857                    }
1858                    return xor;
1859                default:
1860                    throw new AstException();
1861            }
1862        }

1876        private IrExpr visit(AstUnion ast) {
1877            IrExpr left = compile(ast.left());
1878            IrExpr right = compile(ast.right());
1879
1880            if (getCommonSupertype(ast).arity() == 1) {
1881                if (Util.pairwise(
1882                        getUnionType(ast.left()).stream().map(ProductType::getClaferType),
1883                        getUnionType(ast.right()).stream().map(ProductType::getClaferType))
1884                        .anyMatch(Pair.uncurry(AstUtil::isDisjoint))) {
1885                    return unionDisjoint(asSet(left), asSet(right));
1886                }
1887                return union(asSet(left), asSet(right));
1888            }
1889
1890            IrSetExpr[] leftArray = IrUtil.asArray(asRelation(left, getCommonSupertype(ast.left())));
1891            IrSetExpr[] rightArray = IrUtil.asArray(asRelation(right, getCommonSupertype(ast.left())));
1892            assert leftArray.length == rightArray.length;
1893            IrSetExpr[] union = new IrSetExpr[leftArray.length];
1894            for (int i = 0; i < union.length; i++) {
1895                union[i] = union(leftArray[i], rightArray[i]);
1896            }
1897            return array(union);
1898        }

1900        private IrExpr visit(AstMembership ast) {
1901            Object memberComparand = compileComparand(ast.member());
1902            Object setComparand = compileComparand(ast.set());
1903            if (memberComparand instanceof StringSet || setComparand instanceof StringSet) {
1904                IrBoolExpr in = asStringSet(memberComparand).subsetEq(asStringSet(setComparand));
1905                return AstMembership.Op.In.equals(ast.op()) ? in : not(in);
1906            }
1907            IrExpr member = (IrExpr) memberComparand;
1908            IrExpr set = (IrExpr) setComparand;
1909            if (member instanceof IrIntExpr && set instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1910                return AstMembership.Op.In.equals(ast.op())
1911                        ? equal((IrIntExpr) member, (IrIntExpr) set)
1912                        : notEqual((IrIntExpr) member, (IrIntExpr) set);
1913            }
1914            if (member instanceof IrIntExpr && set instanceof IrSetExpr) {
1915                return AstMembership.Op.In.equals(ast.op())
1916                        ? member((IrIntExpr) member, (IrSetExpr) set)
1917                        : notMember((IrIntExpr) member, (IrSetExpr) set);
1918            }
1919            if (member instanceof IrSetExpr && set instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1920                return AstMembership.Op.In.equals(ast.op())
1921                        ? equal((IrSetExpr) member, singleton((IrIntExpr) set))
1922                        : notEqual((IrSetExpr) member, singleton((IrIntExpr) set));
1923            }
1924            return AstMembership.Op.In.equals(ast.op())
1925                    ? subsetEq(asSet(member), asSet(set))
1926                    : not(subsetEq(asSet(member), asSet(set)));
1927        }

1933            if (consequent instanceof IrIntExpr && alternative instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1934                return ternary(antecedent, (IrIntExpr) consequent, (IrIntExpr) alternative);
1935            }
1936            return ternary(antecedent, asSet(consequent), asSet(alternative));
