1943        private IrExpr visit(AstDowncast ast) {
1944            AstSetExpr base = ast.base();
1945            int offset = getOffset((AstAbstractClafer) getCommonSupertype(base).getClaferType(), ast.target().getClaferType());
1946
1947            int scope = getScope(ast.target().getClaferType());
1948            IrExpr $base = compile(ast.base());
1949            if ($base instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1950                IrIntExpr intBase = (IrIntExpr) $base;
1951                Domain domain = intBase.getDomain();
1952                if (domain.getLowBound() >= offset && domain.getHighBound() < offset + scope) {
1953                    return sub(intBase, constant(offset));
1954                }
1955                // The base may be an instance of another subclafer, e.g., `this` of an abstract
1956                // clafer downcast to one of its subclafers: the result is a set, empty then.
1957                return mask(singleton(intBase), offset, offset + scope);
1958            }
1959            return mask((IrSetExpr) $base, offset, offset + scope);
1960        }
1961
1962        private IrExpr visit(AstUpcast ast) {
1963            IrExpr base = compile(ast.base());
1964            if (base instanceof IrIntExpr) {
1965                int offset = getOffset((AstAbstractClafer) ast.target().getClaferType(), getCommonSupertype(ast.base()).getClaferType());
1966                return add((IrIntExpr) base, constant(offset));
1967            } else if (base instanceof IrSetExpr) {
1968                int offset = getOffset((AstAbstractClafer) ast.target().getClaferType(), getCommonSupertype(ast.base()).getClaferType());
1969                return offset((IrSetExpr) base, offset);
1970            } else if (base instanceof IrIntArrayExpr) {
1971                int paramOffset = getOffset(ast.target().get(0), getCommonSupertype(ast.base()).get(0));
1972                int returnOffset = getOffset(ast.target().get(1), getCommonSupertype(ast.base()).get(1));
1973                int scope = getScope(ast.target().get(0));
1974                int uninitializedRef = getUninitalizedRef(ast.target().get(1));
1975                IrIntArrayExpr baseArray = (IrIntArrayExpr) base;
1976                IrIntExpr[] array = new IrIntExpr[scope];
1977                Arrays.fill(array, constant(uninitializedRef));
1978                for (int i = 0; i < baseArray.length(); i++) {
1979                    array[i + paramOffset] = add(get(baseArray, i), returnOffset);
1980                }
1981                return array(array);
1982            } else if (base instanceof IrSetArrayExpr) {
1983                int paramOffset = getOffset(ast.target().get(0), getCommonSupertype(ast.base()).get(0));
1984                int returnOffset = getOffset(ast.target().get(1), getCommonSupertype(ast.base()).get(1));
1985                int scope = getScope(ast.target().get(0));
1986                IrSetArrayExpr baseArray = (IrSetArrayExpr) base;
1987                IrSetExpr[] array = new IrSetExpr[scope];
1988                Arrays.fill(array, EmptySet);
1989                for (int i = 0; i < baseArray.length(); i++) {
1990                    array[i + paramOffset] = offset(get(baseArray, i), returnOffset);
1991                }
1992                return array(array);
1993            }
1994            throw new AstException();
1995        }

2001        private Triple<AstLocal, IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr>[][] compileDecl(AstDecl decl) {
2002            IrExpr body = compile(decl.getBody());
2003            if (body instanceof IrIntExpr) {
2004                IrIntExpr intBody = (IrIntExpr) body;
2005                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
2006                Triple<AstLocal, IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr>[] labeledPermutation = new Triple[decl.getLocals().length];
2007                for (int i = 0; i < labeledPermutation.length; i++) {
2008                    labeledPermutation[i] = new Triple<>(
2009                            decl.getLocals()[i], intBody, True);
2010                }
2011                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
2012                Triple<AstLocal, IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr>[][] labeledSequence = new Triple[][]{labeledPermutation};
2013                return labeledSequence;
2014            }
2015            if (body instanceof IrSetExpr) {
2016                IrSetExpr setBody = (IrSetExpr) body;
2017                Domain env = setBody.getEnv();
2018                Domain ker = setBody.getKer();
2019                if (env.isEmpty()) {
2020                    return new Triple[][]{};
2021                }
2022                // TODO: need a different strategy otherwise
2023                assert env.getLowBound() >= 0;
2024                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
2025                Pair<IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr>[] members = new Pair[env.getHighBound() + 1];
2026                for (int i = 0; i < env.getLowBound(); i++) {
2027                    members[i] = new Pair<>(constant(i), False);
2028                }
2029                for (int i = env.getLowBound(); i <= env.getHighBound(); i++) {
2030                    members[i] = new Pair<>(constant(i),
2031                            ker.contains(i) ? True
2032                                    : bool(Util.intercalate("/", AstUtil.getNames(decl.getLocals())) + "#" + i + "#" + localCount++));
2033                }
2034                module.addConstraint(boolChannel(Pair.mapSnd(members), setBody));
2035                if (decl.isDisjoint() && members.length < decl.getLocals().length) {
2036                    return null;
2037                }
2038                Pair<IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr>[][] sequence = decl.isDisjoint() ? Util.permutations(members,
2039                        decl.getLocals().length) : Util.sequence(members, decl.getLocals().length);
2040
2041                @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
2042                Triple<AstLocal, IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr>[][] labeledSequence = new Triple[sequence.length][];
2043                for (int i = 0; i < labeledSequence.length; i++) {
2044                    Pair<IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr>[] permutation = sequence[i];
2045                    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
2046                    Triple<AstLocal, IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr>[] labeledPermutation = new Triple[permutation.length];
2047                    for (int j = 0; j < labeledPermutation.length; j++) {
2048                        labeledPermutation[j] = new Triple<>(
2049                                decl.getLocals()[j], permutation[j]);
2050                    }
2051                    labeledSequence[i] = labeledPermutation;
2052                }
2053                return labeledSequence;
2054            }
2055            throw new AstException();
2056        }

2058        // TODO optimize SOME
2059        private IrExpr visit(AstQuantify ast) {
2060            AstDecl decls[] = ast.decls();
2061            @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
2062            Triple<AstLocal, IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr>[][][] compiledDecls = new Triple[decls.length][][];
2063            for (int i = 0; i < compiledDecls.length; i++) {
2064                compiledDecls[i] = compileDecl(decls[i]);
2065                if (compiledDecls[i] == null) {
2066                    // UNSAT
2067                    return False;
2068                }
2069            }
2070            compiledDecls = Util.sequence(compiledDecls);
2071
2072            List<IrBoolExpr> compiled = new ArrayList<>();
2073            for (Triple<AstLocal, IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr>[][] quants : compiledDecls) {
2074                List<IrBoolExpr> constraints = new ArrayList<>();
2075                for (Triple<AstLocal, IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr>[] quantDecls : quants) {
2076                    for (Triple<AstLocal, IrIntExpr, IrBoolExpr> quantLocals : quantDecls) {
2077                        constraints.add(quantLocals.getThd());
2078                        locals.put(quantLocals.getFst(), quantLocals.getSnd());
2079                    }
2080                }
2081                IrBoolExpr compiledBody = compile(ast.body());
2082                if (Quantifier.All.equals(ast.quantifier())) {
2083                    compiled.add(implies(and(constraints), compiledBody));
2084                } else {
2085                    constraints.add(compiledBody);
2086                    compiled.add(and(constraints));
2087                }
2088            }
2089
2090            switch (ast.quantifier()) {
2091                case All:
2092                    return and(compiled);
2093                case Lone:
2094                    return lone(compiled);
2095                case None:
2096                    return not(or(compiled));
2097                case One:
2098                    return one(compiled);
2099                case Some:
2100                    return or(compiled);
2101                default:
2102                    throw new AstException();
2103            }
2104        }

2155                return inverse(filterNotEqual((IrIntArrayExpr) relation, getUninitalizedRef(returnType)), getScope(returnType));
2156            }
2157            if (relation instanceof IrSetArrayExpr) {

2168                AstClafer returnType = type.getCommonSupertype().get(1);
2169                // TODO use asRelation
2170                return transitiveClosure(filterNotEqual((IrIntArrayExpr) relation, getUninitalizedRef(returnType)), ast.reflexive());
2171            }
2172            if (relation instanceof IrSetArrayExpr) {
2173                return transitiveClosure((IrSetArrayExpr) relation, ast.reflexive());
2174            }
2175            // Bug.
2176            throw new AstException("Should not have passed type checking.");

2179        private IrExpr visit(AstConnected ast) {
2180            // TODO node instanceof IrIntExpr
2181            IrSetExpr nodes = (IrSetExpr) compile(ast.nodes());
2182            IrExpr relation = compile(ast.relation());
2183
2184            IrBoolExpr[] membership = null;
2185            if (ast.nodes() instanceof AstGlobal) {
2186                membership = memberships.get(((AstGlobal) ast.nodes()).type());
2187            }
2188
2189            IrSetArrayExpr transitiveClosure = transitiveClosure(asRelation(relation, getCommonSupertype(ast.relation())), !ast.directed());
2190            IrBoolExpr[] connectedClosure = new IrBoolExpr[transitiveClosure.length()];
2191            for (int i = 0; i < connectedClosure.length; i++) {
2192                connectedClosure[i] = implies(
2193                        membership == null ? member(constant(i), nodes) : membership[i],
2194                        subsetEq(nodes, get(transitiveClosure, i)));
2195            }
2196
2197            return and(connectedClosure);
2198        }

2206    /**
2207     * Build the child set for the Clafer.
2208     *
2209     * @param clafer the Clafer
2210     * @return the variables to represent the child relation
2211     */
2212    private IrSetVar[] buildChildSet(AstConcreteClafer clafer) {
2213        assert Format.LowGroup.equals(getFormat(clafer));
2214
2215        int parentScope = getScope(clafer.getParent());
2216        PartialSolution partialParentSolution = getPartialSolution(clafer.getParent());
2217
2218        int claferScope = getScope(clafer);
2219        Card card = getCard(clafer);
2220        assert card.hasHigh();
2221
2222        int low = 0;
2223        int high = card.getHigh();
2224        int max = claferScope - 1;
2225
2226        IrSetVar[] skip = new IrSetVar[parentScope];
2227        for (int i = 0; i < skip.length; i++) {
2228            if (low <= max) {
2229                Domain env = boundDomain(low, Math.min(high - 1, max));
2230                Domain ker = EmptyDomain;
2231                if (partialParentSolution.hasClafer(i)) {
2232                    int prevHigh = high - card.getHigh();
2233                    int nextLow = low + card.getLow();
2234                    if (nextLow > prevHigh) {
2235                        ker = boundDomain(prevHigh, Math.min(nextLow - 1, max));
2236                    }
2237                }
2238                int cardLow = Math.max(card.getLow(), ker.size());
2239                int cardHigh = Math.min(card.getHigh(), env.size());
2240                Domain cardDomain = cardLow <= cardHigh
2241                        ? boundDomain(cardLow, cardHigh)
2242                        // Cannot exist
2243                        : EmptyDomain;
2244                cardDomain = partialParentSolution.hasClafer(i) ? cardDomain : cardDomain.insert(0);
2245                skip[i] = set(clafer.getName() + "#" + i, env, ker, cardDomain);
2246            } else {
2247                skip[i] = EmptySet;
2248            }
2249            if (partialParentSolution.hasClafer(i)) {
2250                low += card.getLow();
2251            }
2252            high += card.getHigh();
2253        }
2254        return skip;
2255    }
2256
2257    /**
2258     * Create the parent pointers for the Clafer.
2259     *
2260     * @param clafer the Clafer
2261     * @return the variables to represent the parent relation
2262     */
2263    private IrIntVar[] buildParentPointers(AstConcreteClafer clafer) {
2264        PartialSolution solution = getPartialSolution(clafer);
2265        boolean known = solution.parentSolutionKnown();
2266        IrIntVar[] pointers = new IrIntVar[solution.size()];
2267        for (int i = 0; i < pointers.length; i++) {
2268            int[] possibleParents = solution.getPossibleParents(i);
2269            pointers[i] = enumInt(clafer.getName() + "@Parent#" + i,
2270                    solution.hasClafer(i) || known
2271                            ? possibleParents
2272                            : Util.snoc(possibleParents, getScope(clafer.getParent())));
2273        }
2274        return pointers;
2275    }
2276
2277    private void buildRef(AstConcreteClafer clafer) {
2278        AstRef ref = AstUtil.getInheritedRef(clafer);
2279        if (ref != null) {
2280            if (ref.getTargetType() instanceof AstStringClafer) {
2281                refStrings.put(clafer, buildStrings(ref, clafer));
2282            } else {
2283                refPointers.put(clafer, buildRefPointers(ref, clafer));
2284            }
2285        }
2286    }
2287
2288    /**
2289     * Create the references pointers for the Clafer.
2290     *
2291     * @param ref the reference Clafer
2292     * @return the variables to represent the reference relation
2293     */
2294    private IrIntVar[] buildRefPointers(AstRef ref, AstConcreteClafer context) {
2295        AstClafer src = ref.getSourceType();
2296        AstClafer tar = ref.getTargetType();
2297
2298        assert !(tar instanceof AstStringClafer);
2299        assert ref == AstUtil.getInheritedRef(context);
2300
2301        PartialSolution partialSolution = getPartialSolution(context);
2302        Domain[] partialInts = getPartialInts(context);
2303        Domain refRange = getRefRange(ref);
2304        IrIntVar[] ivs = new IrIntVar[getScope(context)];
2305
2306        for (int i = 0; i < ivs.length; i++) {
2307            Domain domain = partialInts[i];
2308            if (domain == null) {
2309                domain = refRange;
2310            }
2311            if (partialSolution.hasClafer(i)) {
2312                if (domain.isEmpty()) {
2313                    // the constraints leave no value for a reference that must exist
2314                    throw new UnsatisfiableException();
2315                }
2316                ivs[i] = domainInt(src.getName() + "@Ref" + i, domain);
2317            } else {
2318                ivs[i] = domainInt(src.getName() + "@Ref" + i, domain.insert(getUninitalizedRef(tar)));
2319            }
2320        }
2321
2322        return ivs;
2323    }
2324
2325    /**
2326     * The pointers of a reference to a subtype of the target as pointers to the target: an
2327     * instance of the subtype is at its offset in the target, and an uninitialized pointer is
2328     * the target's uninitialized pointer.
2329     *
2330     * @param pointers the pointers into the subtype
2331     * @param subtype the subtype
2332     * @param target the target
2333     * @return the pointers into the target
2334     */
2335    private IrIntVar[] retargetRefPointers(IrIntVar[] pointers, AstClafer subtype, AstClafer target) {
2336        int offset = getOffset(target, subtype);
2337        int uninitialized = getUninitalizedRef(subtype);
2338        int targetUninitialized = getUninitalizedRef(target);
2339        IrIntExpr[] table = new IrIntExpr[uninitialized + 1];
2340        for (int i = 0; i < uninitialized; i++) {
2341            table[i] = constant(i + offset);
2342        }
2343        table[uninitialized] = constant(targetUninitialized);
2344        IrIntVar[] retargeted = new IrIntVar[pointers.length];
2345        for (int i = 0; i < pointers.length; i++) {
2346            Domain domain = enumDomain(pointers[i].getDomain().stream()
2347                    .map(value -> value == uninitialized ? targetUninitialized : value + offset));
2348            retargeted[i] = domainInt(pointers[i].getName() + "@" + target.getName(), domain);
2349            module.addConstraint(equal(retargeted[i], element(table, pointers[i])));
2350        }
2351        return retargeted;
2352    }
2353
2354    private IrStringVar[] buildStrings(AstRef ref, AstConcreteClafer context) {
2355        AstClafer src = ref.getSourceType();
2356        AstClafer tar = ref.getTargetType();
2357
2358        assert tar instanceof AstStringClafer;
2359        assert ref == AstUtil.getInheritedRef(context);
2360
2361        int stringLength = analysis.getScope().getStringLength();
2362        char charLow = analysis.getScope().getCharLow();
2363        char charHigh = analysis.getScope().getCharHigh();
2364        Domain charDomain = boundDomain(charLow, charHigh).insert(0);
2365        IrStringVar[] svs = new IrStringVar[getScope(context)];
2366
2367        for (int i = 0; i < svs.length; i++) {
2368            IrIntVar[] chars = new IrIntVar[stringLength];
2369            for (int j = 0; j < chars.length; j++) {
2370                chars[j] = domainInt(src.getName() + "@String" + i + "[" + j + "]", charDomain);
2371            }
2372            svs[i] = string(src.getName(), chars,
2373                    boundInt(src.getName() + "@Length" + i, 0, stringLength));
2374        }
2375
2376        return svs;
2377    }
2378
2379    /**
2380     * Enforce the size of a set to be within the cardinality.
2381     *
2382     * @param setCard the set to constrain
2383     * @param card the cardinality
2384     * @return card.low &le; |setCard| &le; card.high
2385     */
2386    private IrBoolExpr constrainCard(IrIntExpr setCard, Card card) {
2387        if (card.isExact()) {
2388            return equal(setCard, card.getLow());
2389        }
2390        if (card.hasLow() && card.hasHigh()) {
2391            return member(setCard, constant(boundDomain(card.getLow(), card.getHigh())));
2392        }
2393        if (card.hasLow()) {
2394            return greaterThanEqual(setCard, card.getLow());
2395        }
2396        if (card.hasHigh()) {
2397            return lessThanEqual(setCard, card.getHigh());
2398        }
2399        return True;
2400    }

2402    /*
2403     ************************
2404     * Convenience functions.
2405     ************************
2406     */
2407    /**
2408     * Some references use an extra value for uninitialized. For example:
2409     *
2410     * <pre>
2411     * A 2
2412     * B -> A *
2413     * </pre>
2414     *
2415     * The references of B are encoded using integers with domain {0,1,2}, where
2416     * the values 0 and 1 correspond to A$0 and A$1. The value 2 is used for Bs
2417     * that are absent. Consider the following instance:
2418     *
2419     * <pre>
2420     * A$0
2421     * A$1
2422     * B$0 -> A$1
2423     * B$1 -> A$0
2424     * </pre>
2425     *
2426     * If the {@code scope(B) = 3}, then the references of B are represented as
2427     * the following:
2428     *
2429     * <pre>
2430     * B$0ref = 1
2431     * B$1ref = 0
2432     * B$2ref = 2
2433     * </pre>
2434     *
2435     * @param clafer to Clafer referred to
2436     * @return the integer value for uninitialized.
2437     */
2438    private int getUninitalizedRef(AstClafer clafer) {
2439        if (clafer instanceof AstDecimalClafer) {
2440            return analysis.getScope().getDecimalHigh() + 1;
2441        }
2442        return clafer instanceof AstIntClafer
2443                ? analysis.getScope().getIntHigh() + 1
2444                : getScope(clafer);
2445    }
2446

2470    private Domain getRefRange(AstRef ref) {

2475        if (target instanceof AstDecimalClafer) {
2476            return getDecimalRange();
2477        }
2478        return fromToDomain(0, getScope(target));
2479    }

2525    private static interface Symmetry {

2527        IrExpr[] getInput();
2528
2529        IrExpr[] getOutput();
2530
2531        IrBoolExpr getConstraint();

2534    private static class LexChainChannel implements Symmetry {
2535
2536        private final IrIntExpr[][] strings;
2537        private final IrIntExpr[] ints;
2538
2539        LexChainChannel(IrIntExpr[][] strings, IrIntExpr[] ints) {
2540            this.strings = strings;
2541            this.ints = ints;
2542        }
2543
2544        @Override
2545        public IrExpr[] getInput() {
2546            return Util.concat(strings);
2547        }
2548
2549        @Override
2550        public IrExpr[] getOutput() {
2551            return ints;
2552        }
2553
2554        @Override
2555        public IrBoolExpr getConstraint() {
2556            return sortChannel(strings, ints);
2557        }
